facts.rationale: Called by ftSk_SpecialHi_Coll when the ground-support check returns zero. The complete body converts to airborne movement, changes to state 0x168 at the current frame with speed 1 and flags 0x0C4C508A, and assigns accessory4_cb = fn_80113038. Unlike the travel helper, it does not set invisibility or x2223_b4. Nearby ending-entry routines clear invisibility, install the same accessory callback, and enter the ending states. The End qualifier distinguishes the actual phase without importing Mewtwo's potentially confusing Lost terminology.
